name: ainet_load_all_from_zrd
description: AINet::LoadAllFromZrd probes numbered AI network ZRD files from net_01.zrd through net_99.zrd.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call AINet source target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x402fd0 validates a no-argument cdecl loop that starts netId at 1, calls AINet::LoadFromZrd with ECX=netId, increments, and stops when netId reaches 100.
The native smoke writes net_00.zrd, net_01.zrd, net_99.zrd, and net_100.zrd, runs AINet::LoadAllFromZrd, and verifies that only net IDs 1 and 99 are loaded into the global AINet list.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x402fd0 --build-root build\vc5-verify-402fd0-probe passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 4 relocation-masked bytes under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 21, VC object symbol size 32, 11 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
